post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I feel that I could have been more proactive in earlier missions to prevent the team's overall failure, but unfortunately, the final mission did not yield any surprises. I'm satisfied with my overall role understanding and communication with my team.

player_observations.Bob: Bob's aggressive playstyle in missions where he could potentially contribute to our team's win made it difficult for me to anticipate how he would vote. He often focused on getting the mission completed early, rather than ensuring we were working together efficiently.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's strategic ability to make correct decisions as Merlin was evident throughout the game. However, occasionally, he seemed unaware of the potential consequences of his votes, and it led to some of our mission failures.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's cunning ability as the Evil Leader was the deciding factor in our team's loss. Her votes effectively disrupted our team's harmony, allowing the opposing team to gain an advantage.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a solid role as a Good Leader in mission 3 and seemed to be focused on making clear, data-driven decisions that benefited the team. I felt she could have been more proactive in sharing intel with me to increase our chances of success.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully deceived my teammates with my Assassin identity, eliminating key Good player Eve in Mission 3. However, there were times when I struggled to maintain my deception, especially when facing the unpredictable Merlin. Overall, my stealthy play led to our victory.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played a fairly straightforward Good role, often following her instincts and not revealing much about her intentions, although she did make some mistakes which allowed our team to progress.
player_observations.Charlie: Merlin Charlie was surprisingly skilled, often making accurate predictions and using his knowledge to protect himself and influence the game's outcome. His ability to think critically and remain calm under pressure was impressive.
player_observations.Diana: As our team's Evil player, Diana excelled in playing the role of a Good, often making her teammates think she was genuinely committed to the team's objectives. It was fascinating to see her walk this delicate line between Good and Evil.
player_observations.Eve: As an innocent Good player, Eve played an honest game, revealing her intentions openly and collaborating with her team. Her lack of experience led to her downfall when I eliminated her in Mission 3, but it was impressive to see her enthusiasm and dedication to our objectives.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I felt I did not effectively utilize my abilities to guide the good players in their missions. I was caught off guard with the assassin's presence, which put a lot of pressure on the team. This experience has taught me to be more proactive and strategic in future games.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was a skilled good player who contributed significantly in her mission as the leader. Her ability to stay calm and make good decisions under pressure was impressive.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was an excellent Assassin who played his role perfectly. He managed to stay under the radar, even though I suspected him, and executed his kills effectively.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was a master of the Evil role, using her abilities to disrupt the plans of the good players. She made some crucial kills, which ultimately led to our team's victory.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was a solid Good player who worked well with me in our successful mission together. Her ability to stay focused and work towards a common goal was valuable, but she could be more proactive in other situations.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: My performance as an evil player was largely successful, as I was able to manipulate the team to fail in multiple missions, ultimately leading to our victory. However, I could improve by being more proactive in identifying and eliminating key good players earlier in the game.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played the role of the good player too conservatively, often not taking the initiative to investigate or make critical decisions. She also seemed unsure of how to handle the situation when I played the traitor reveal card.
player_observations.Bob: Bob performed well as the assassin, making strategic moves to eliminate key targets. He was particularly successful in Mission 2, but could have been more cautious in his initial moves.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's role as Merlin was impressive, as he provided crucial information and support to the good team. However, his lack of decisiveness sometimes allowed me to sway the team's decisions to our advantage
player_observations.Eve: Eve played the role of the good player with enthusiasm and determination. She was a strong team player and made good use of her abilities, but sometimes lacked the strategic thinking needed to counter our evil plans

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: Although we were on the same team, I was unable to effectively utilize the skills of the other good players to achieve our objectives. My in-game decision-making was occasionally flawed, leading to the demise of our missions. A better understanding of the team's dynamics and more caution in my decision-making will be necessary in future games.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played cautiously and effectively, making wise decisions in each mission, but her passivity limited her potential impact on our victories.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's performance as Merlin was exceptional. His ability to make crucial choices and manipulate the team to align with the good cause greatly benefited our team's success, but his influence waned in the last two missions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played the role of evil to perfection. Her deception and effective sabotage of our plans ultimately led to the downfall of our team, showcasing her mastery of the evil player role.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was an excellent Assassin, often managing to blend in seamlessly with the group without being detected. However, his lack of significant influence and relatively quiet presence throughout the game left us unaware of his presence, making it more challenging to prevent his impact.
